# Drive Exotiq

> Good cars. Better company. A driving community and the front door to the upcoming exotiq.rent marketplace.

This Astra build is an independent design preview. Preview forms validate input without saving information or sending messages. Rentals are not available to book here.

Drive Exotiq brings together owners and enthusiasts for small sunrise drives and Cars & Coffee. The proposed rhythm is the last Sunday of the month; confirmed dates, routes and meet points are shared through invitations. The Denver–Miami journey and wrap are completed. The roadbook uses verified endpoints and clearly captioned archive photographs; it does not assert unverified mileage, dates or intermediate stops. Brand and event partnership inquiries have their own form.

## Pages

- [Home](/): the road is calling
- [The drives](/drives): invitation process and frequently asked questions
- [The roadbook](/tour): completed journey and archive
- [The garage](/marketplace): upcoming exotiq.rent marketplace
- [The journal](/blog): stories from the road
- [Get on the list](/apply?interest=drives): driving community invitation
- [Partnerships](/sponsor): introduce your brand
